The keeper sat a long while, gulls wheeling overhead, then went inside to find paper, an envelope, and a map of Canada.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市仍在浅睡。街道空旷，路灯把梧桐的影子拉得很长。早点铺冒出第一缕白汽，环卫工人的扫帚声在楼宇间沙沙回荡。写字楼的灯还亮着几盏，像熬夜的眼睛。天空由墨蓝渐渐泛出鱼肚白。远处，第一班公交驶过寂静的站台。整座城市屏住呼吸，等待黎明按下重启键。", "w03": "• Imagine you're in a line of dominoes: you do one small step, then hand the job to the next domino.\n• Each domino repeats the same simple step on a smaller piece of the problem, until the last domino just stops—that's the base case.\n• Finally, all the little answers stack back up, one on top of another, until the whole job is finished."}
